[[File:ChocolateCoveredCambyBerries.png|thumb|250px|Chocolate Covered Camby Berries]]
'''Chocolate''' or '''chokolate''' was a sweet food. It could be eaten on its own, or used as an ingredient in beverages such as [[Hot chocolate/Legends|hot chocolate]], or in desserts such as cake, [[ladybabies]] and [[white-chocolate bread pudding]].

Sometimes, the word "chocolate" used alone actually referred to the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] drink [[Hot chocolate/Legends|hot chocolate]].

Variations included [[Trammistan chocolate]].

==History==
During the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Festival of Love]], the Ewoks used chocolate to coat [[Cambylictus berry|Camby berries]] to create [[Cambylictus berry|Chocolate Covered Camby Berries]].

[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was known to like chocolate, with the [[Gracious Government Mix]] being deemed his favorites.

After the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], chocolate became a rarity, because the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] had re-[[Shaping protocol|shaped]] seven of the eight planets that were home to the plant that produced the pods that were used to make it.<ref name="TJK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>
